root_idea.summary: The root centers on tending, attending to, and managing something or someone.
root_idea.development: From the idea of a caretaker or shepherd who continually attends to what is entrusted to him, the root develops into meanings of managing dependents or property and of granting a person possessions or benefits to care for.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form II perfect citation form.
Displayed under the singular kinship noun citation form خَال.
The Quranic plural is normalized to the supported singular citation form خَالَة.

senses.definition: To bestow on someone; to grant or confer possession of something as a favor.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrences, the object is something granted to a person. The lexical discussion connects the grant with dependents or with possessions that require care and management.
The Quranic group includes the plural أخوال and the inflected singular خالك.
The Quranic group consists of the plural خالات in inflected forms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become possessed of dependents or attendants after having been alone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I verbal use concerning acquiring خَوَل or household dependents.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pasture, tend, and manage livestock or camels well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with livestock or property under one's care.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rule or govern people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A governing use with people as the object of management.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have maternal uncles, or to have many maternal uncles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV use describing a person's maternal-uncle relations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To perceive in someone an indication or sign of good.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The perceived good is treated as an indication, symptom, mark, or token.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To attend to or visit someone or something repeatedly and keep it in good condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of repeated attention to people, admonition, land, or another object of care.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take people as slaves, servants, or other dependents.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The people are treated as خَوَل, including household dependents.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take or adopt someone as a maternal uncle, or to call him one's maternal uncle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional kinship-adoption use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask someone to lend livestock or camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized livestock-lending construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An owner of a horse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression أنا خال هذا الفرس, “I am the owner of this horse.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: A manager, tender, keeper, or guardian of livestock, property, or affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The use can refer to a good livestock manager, a pastor who tends people or animals, or one who puts a thing or affairs into good order.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An indication, sign, mark, or token of good in a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal sign or quality interpreted as evidence of good.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mole or dark mark resembling a pimple on the face or body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical or bodily mark; its plural is خيلان.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A military banner or standard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term denotes the army banner called لواء.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A soft Yemeni garment or cloth with a red or brown ground and black lines or stripes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A named type of برد fabric.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A black stallion-camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Slaves, servants, cattle, and other dependents placed under a person's care or given to him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a collective or quasi-plural and sometimes for a single male or female dependent; one reported analysis relates it to خائل, “pastor.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gift or gifts.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use preserved in the expression كثُر الخَوَل, “he has many gifts.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pastors or caretakers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported analysis of خَوَل as a plural or quasi-plural related to خائل, “pastor.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lower part of the socket or head of an axe-bit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical implement term attributed to one lexical authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A female gazelle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A zoological noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A measurer of land using a measuring cane.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A professional designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The relationship of a maternal uncle or maternal aunt.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A kinship noun used in expressions describing the relationship between two people.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A giver of many gifts.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agent noun describing a person characterized by generous giving.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Scattered or dispersed, especially one after another like sparks flying from beaten iron.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reduplicated expression أخول أخول describes scattering; some usage treats أخول itself as “sparks.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: Prouder than another person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the comparative construction أخول من فلان.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man having maternal uncles, especially many maternal uncles.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive or resultant description of a man's maternal-uncle relations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Naturally adapted or disposed to good.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes a person inclined by nature to be, do, produce, or bring about what is good.
